sample_unit: post-transplant clinical scenarios (algorithms scored by 3 transplant specialists)

links.outcome: Clinical concordance of LLM transplant algorithms, compared across two candidate models on identical prompts
links.effect: Gemini 2.5 Pro achieved a higher median Clinical Concordance score than GPT-4 (4.5 vs 3.8, P < .01) and higher Logical Flow and Completeness scores.
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro achieved a higher median Clinical Concordance score than GPT-4 (4.5 vs 3.8, P < .01) and higher Logical Flow and Completeness scores.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLMs for drafting clinical protocols/algorithms using specialist-rated rubric (concordance, logical flow, completeness)

screen.reason: Compares performance of two LLMs (GPT-4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro) in generating post-transplant clinical algorithms via expert rubric evaluation, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
